headings.usage: Use for all primary dashboard numbers, net worth values, and section headings.

body.usage: Use for all labels, descriptions, secondary data, and standard text.

monospace.usage: CRITICAL: Use for all financial figures, balances, percentages, and asset tickers to ensure tabular alignment.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Control Room Grid. High data density, sharp structural divisions, zero decorative gradients. Calm and trustworthy interface.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento grid setup (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Gap strategy: gap-4 or gap-6.
layout_and_spacing.containers: Flat surfaces with 1px border (border-border/40). No heavy box shadows. Corner radius maximum 8px (rounded-md) or completely sharp.
layout_and_spacing.internal_padding: Generous internal padding for cards (p-6) to maintain breathing room.

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky side or top nav with optical clarity (bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border/40). Keep it minimal.
components_strategy.cards: Cardless or flat cards. Do NOT use heavy default shadcn card shadows. Use subtle hover states (-translate-y-[1px] with border-white/20).
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn Recharts. Use monochromatic or tightly clustered palettes (see chart_palette) rather than rainbow colors to maintain the calm aesthetic. Tooltips must have Space Mono values.
components_strategy.tables: Dense layout. Align right for all numerical columns. Use Space Mono for numbers and percentages.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-neutral-200. Secondary: border border-border bg-transparent hover:bg-neutral-800.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Dialog, Form, Input, Select. Keep inputs sharp (rounded-md) with clear focus rings (focus-visible:ring-white).

accessibility_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must lighten on hover and explicitly declare text color.
accessibility_and_interactions.test_ids: CRITICAL: Add data-testid to all buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and critical metric displays.

media_and_icons.icon_style: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a sharp, technical look.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace the CSS variables in frontend/src/index.css to match the strict dark theme and set `.dark` class by default on the HTML tag.
2. Add Google Fonts (Outfit, Manrope, Space Mono) to frontend/public/index.html.
3. Build the dashboard using a strict CSS grid. Make the Hero Net Worth card span full width on mobile, and at least 2 cols on desktop.
4. For Charts: Use Shadcn's chart wrapper. For the portfolio pie chart, strictly use the provided monochrome chart_palette.
5. Formatting: Use 'Space Mono' strictly for formatting currency ($X,XXX.XX), percentages (+X.XX%), and asset tickers (BTC, AAPL).
6. Do not implement complex auth, keep it single-user using local state/localStorage or a simple local DB.
7. Implement standard Shadcn UI components but strip away heavy rounding (force `rounded-md` max in tailwind.config.js).
